Name: Vanilla Tweaks Style SVE Seeds
Author: MarsCBG
Description:
Replaces the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded Seeds[/url] and Saplings with ones in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21284]Vanilla Tweaks[/url] style.

Note: I didn't replace the seeds that don't use seedbags nor the uniquely styled Golden Carrot seed bag as I believe they work well as is.
[s]
It has Saturation and Seasonal options, however due to limitations with Content Patcher they've got to be set separately from the main Vanilla Tweaks Mod.[/s]

[b]NEW IN 2.0.0: [/b]Now uses Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens to grab your settings from the original Vanilla Tweaks-Farming mod so no configuration is required for this mod.

[b][size=4]CREDITS:[/size][/b]

[*]Stardew Valley Expanded by FlashShifter and Contributors
[*]Vanilla Tweaks is by Taiyo and Airyn
[/list]
